# Centered page

A page without the app shell: the brand, one card and a way on, in a column at the middle of the window - sign-in, registration, a password reset, a second factor, an unlock, an enrolment.

## Example

`page-center` on the page's `main` stands its children in a column 30rem (480 px) wide at the middle of the window, and the column grows down when they are taller; `--redz-page-center-width` sets another width. `page-center-brand` holds the logo, the name, one line and the language links; a `card` in the column is raised. `page-center-corner` holds the theme button at the top end of the page: it scrolls with the page, and the column starts below it, so on a phone it never covers the logo or the card.

```html
<div class="page-center">
	<div class="page-center-corner">
		<button class="btn btn-text btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Theme"><i class="bi bi-circle-half" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
	<header class="page-center-brand">
		<span class="app-mark">RZ</span>
		<h2>REDZ CMS</h2>
		<p>Sign in to manage your sites</p>
		<nav aria-label="Language">
			<a href="#page-center-example" lang="en" aria-current="page">English</a>
			<a href="#page-center-example" lang="th">ไทย</a>
			<a href="#page-center-example" lang="ru">Русский</a>
		</nav>
	</header>
	<form class="card">
		<div class="card-body vstack gap-16">
			<div class="form-floating form-adorn">
				<i class="bi bi-envelope" aria-hidden="true"></i>
				<input class="form-control" id="page-center-mail" type="email" placeholder="name@example.com" autocomplete="username">
				<label for="page-center-mail">E-mail</label>
			</div>
			<div class="input-group">
				<div class="form-floating form-adorn">
					<i class="bi bi-key" aria-hidden="true"></i>
					<input class="form-control" id="page-center-password" type="password" placeholder="Password" autocomplete="current-password">
					<label for="page-center-password">Password</label>
				</div>
				<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" commandfor="page-center-password" command="--reveal" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Show the password"><i class="bi bi-eye" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
			</div>
			<button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg w-100" type="submit"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-in-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>Sign in</button>
		</div>
	</form>
	<p class="text-center"><a href="#page-center-example">Forgot the password?</a></p>
</div>
```

In a page `page-center` is the `main` and the brand's name its `h1`; here they are a `div` and an `h2` under the page's own.

## Accessibility

- The page is one `main`; the language links are a `nav` with a name, each link with its `lang`, the current one with `aria-current="page"`.
- The corner comes first in the source so `Tab` meets it before the form; put it after the form when the form should come first.
- A logo image has an `alt` of the name only when the name is not written beside it; otherwise `alt=""`.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/page-center.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/page-center.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-24`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-space-40`, `--redz-page-center-width`, `--redz-shadow-3`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-text`.
